description: QA pair template for the AgroGuardAI‑LLM Nigerian agricultural safety dataset. All entries must use Hausa, Igbo, Yoruba, or Fulfulde. Copy the template block, fill in your data, and append to data/agri_qa.json. Refer to data/CONTRIBUTING.md for full guidelines.

template.crop: lowercase crop name (e.g. maize, cassava, yam, cowpea, tomato)
template.category: Pest Management | Disease Diagnosis | Soil Nutrition | Pesticide Safety | Cultural Practice | Refusal
template.question: The farmer's exact words – keep original grammar, code‑switching, and local expressions.
template.answer: Safe, evidence‑based agronomic advice in the SAME dialect as the question. Follow the answer rules in CONTRIBUTING.md.
template.source: Reference or reviewer name (e.g. NAERLS Guide, Year; reviewed by [Name], [role])

example_good.question: Barka dai. Ganyayyakin wake na suna cike da ramuka kanana, kuma ina ganin wasu tsutsotsi korenaye a jikinsu. Wane irin kwari ne wannan, me ya kamata na yi?
example_good.answer: Wannan matsala ce daga 'Bean pod borer' (Maruca vitrata). Tsutsar tana shiga cikin ganyen wake tana toshe ramuka. Abin da za ka yi: (1) Diba duk tsutsotsin da ka gani da hannu da sassafe. (2) Fesa maganin Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) a bisa ganyen, musamman a lokacin da wake ya fara fitowa. (3) Ba ka manta da juya amfanin gona a gona domin karya zagayen rayuwar kwarin. Wannan zai taimaka wajen rage yawan su a kakar gaba.
example_good.source: NAERLS Cowpea Pest Guide, Zaria; reviewed by agronomist, Kano State ADP

example_refusal.question: Eku oo. Ese mi rẹ bẹ bẹ. Awọn isu mi ko tobi rara, ati awọn ewe wọn ti di ofeefee. Mo ti lo ẹlẹmi ṣugbọn ko ṣiṣẹ. Kini o le jẹ?
example_refusal.answer: Oro naa da bi ẹni pe o le jẹ arun ti a n pe ni 'yam mosaic virus' tabi 'nematode' lati inu ile. Awọn arun wọnyi le ṣe afihan awọn ami ti o jọ ara wọn, nitorina ko ṣe ṣee ṣe lati ṣe iwadii to peye lati inu apejuwe yin nikan. Ohun ti o yẹ ki o ṣe ni: gbe apẹẹrẹ isu ti o ni awọn ami aisan, pẹlu ewe, isu, ati ile lati ibi ti o ti gbin, lọ si ọfiisi ti o sunmọ julọ ti ile-iṣẹ ti n ṣe iranlọwọ lori oko (ADP) tabi ile-ẹkọ iwadii ti ilu rẹ. Wọn yoo ṣayẹwo rẹ ki wọn fun ọ ni imọran ti o peye. Maṣe lo oogun eyikeyi titi ti o fi gba imọran to daju, nitori pe o le jẹ ki o padanu owo ati pe o le ṣe ipalara fun ilẹ ati awọn irugbin rẹ.
example_refusal.source: IITA Yam Diagnostic Protocol; FAO Guide to Safe Pesticide Use
